name: hukuhaka-engineering-plan
description: Create repository-grounded, decision-complete engineering plans and audit their contracts, assumptions, and invariants.

interface.longDescription: Inspect the repository, define observable contracts, construct dependency-ordered changes, challenge important invariants with counterexamples, and map requirements to verification.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $engineering-plan to produce a repository-grounded, decision-complete implementation plan.
